== Missing data ==
* '''Special Premiere cases sent to Lucasfilm.''' Bill remembers Decipher sending special cases of Premiere to Lucasfilm a couple of times. The only documented item is the 2001 Executive Gift Set (Encyclopedia 3.2 p. 109; 3.0 p. 75). An eBay listing quoted on the forum ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=887392 p=887392]) says the sets were for executives "within Lucasfilms, Decipher, and even George Lucas himself!" No source found for earlier presentation cases.
* Caps/hats, jackets, mousepads, store standees/banners, Decipher-branded dice, Star Wars Celebration items: still no source. Decipher Store Wayback captures of /store/black_beauties and /store/categories are ~2 KB JavaScript shells, not merch catalogs. Empty character deck boxes are dested from Noble Knight (1996, 4×4×3 in.); a Vader box is not on that listing. The "Ask Me About Star Wars CCG" badge is now dested from SWCA item 51041. eBay this pass: leftover Cloud City Light Side commons factory trays dested from Hill's Wholesale catalog (Wayback 20260523161214); sealed booster sales left out.
* Players Committee-era trophies, playmats and pins beyond those listed: starwarsccg.org news posts were not reachable for this pass. The Encyclopedia 3.2 (p. 3) says PC promotional items are catalogued on starwarsccg.org.
* Encyclopedia p. 190 shows an uncaptioned poker chip with a gold emblem; left out until a source names it. The p. 169 "twelfth day of Christmas" fold-out is now dested (Talaga names it 1997; printed line "On the twelfth day of Christmas Decipher sent to me").
* TheForce.Net donation article now has Preserved copy 20121001051034 (opened 15 October 2026). Later CDX 200s (20241217005835, 20261010073714, 20261015164911) remain unread.
* Facebook group starwarsccg is private (needs an account). 15 October 2026 signed-in search found [[Matt Manning]] Toys "R" Us OOP window boxes (already dested on [[Unofficial repackaged products]]), Luke Fritz visit to Wild Things Games Salem uncut sheets (uncut stay [[Aftermarket and collecting]]), and an Andy Talaga leftover/empty-box sale. No destable public photos; private personal photos not used. Full-group dump not done.
* Andy Talaga's own YouTube channel. BoardMatt later collecting videos checked via auto-captions: 50ZU0MBMMio and tkOSRJl0vHw are misprints/oversized (already on Aftermarket / Oversized); oTMfJi6o_zE and 2ZXDE7cO4YM are uncut sheets (Aftermarket); hYFUvhQYR3M grading; N463OiYrCMg premium wrap-up (empty character deck boxes already dested). y5AHDbvvv3s and 2ZXDE7cO4YM auto-subs 429. No hats/jackets/mousepads/standees/dice/Celebration in those captions.
* [[Jim Colson]] relics dested as unreleased (PRRkRBHlo-o 39:27); vinyl velcro Death Star / Chewbacca dested in prose (19:42). archive.org item youtube-PRRkRBHlo-o is empty; watch-page Wayback 20261015174310 is the Preserved copy. Grainy webcam stills of the staff photo, giant Collision, and Chewbacca stay prose-only.
* Tournament Sheet from the Pirate Pete kit-contents listing: named on the listing with the Command Card; no separate photo dested (Command Card File dested). FAQ xerox 1 May 1996 in the kit-contents-and-faq listing left as kit contents, not a separate File.

== Possibly faulty data ==
* Card T-shirt back: Encyclopedia 3.2 p. 188 text says the back reads "The Force Is With You"; its own photo (p. 189) and Gregg Keefer's SWCA page read "Never Underestimate the Power of the Force". The article uses the photo/SWCA wording.
* 1999 SWCCG Finalist shirt count is printed as "approximately 120" in 3.2 and "120?" in 3.0.
* Executive Gift Set count: "about 250" (Encyclopedia); CategoryOneGames on the forum thought more than 250 were made.
* Executive Gift Set date: Encyclopedia 3.2 p. 109 says 2001. On the 29 May 2022 [[BoardMatt]] video, Matt Manning places a Christmas party in 1997 or 1998; Talaga agrees the first copies went out unsealed at that party. Article keeps 2001.
* Executive Gift Set contents: Encyclopedia says a cut Premiere Limited set in reverse sheet order (almost two complete sets) plus an Unlimited starter rulebook. Talaga describes a production-ratio cut (1× R1, 2× R2, U1/U2, C1/C2/C3 Stormtrooper/Rebel Trooper) plus a rulebook and filler. Article keeps the encyclopedia.
* Sealed vs unsealed: Talaga says the sets were never factory-sealed and that Wild Things Games (Salem, Oregon) resealed leftover stock. Encyclopedia does not discuss sealing. Left out of the body.
* Staff Christmas-card year: Talaga says 1998 or 1999 from the people on the legend; no copyright line. Article says 1998 or 1999.
* Talaga auto-captions say "12th night" / "gave to me"; the printed card (Encyclopedia p. 169 and the video screen-share) reads "twelfth day" / "sent to me". Article uses the printed line.
* Talaga "fewer than five" Dagobah Limited and Cloud City Limited sell sheets, and that [[Jim Colson]] and Julian also lack Dagobah Limited: dested as Talaga's count ("According to").

== Marginal cuts ==
* The Encyclopedia's card T-shirt photos (p. 189) are illustrations of the layout (the same blank tee with each card), not photos of surviving shirts. Only the Tarkin layout and the back are used.
* Sales sheets per set (Encyclopedia pp. 110–133), German Queen Games ads (pp. 181–182), Japanese ads.
* 2002 World Championship $10,000 purse breakdown ($5,000 / $2,500 / $650 ×2 / $300 ×4), TheForce.Net 5 February 2002.
* 2001 Open Qualifiers: top 8 at each received a trophy (Kyle Heuer, 21 May 2001, Klauser archive mirror).
* Grainy webcam stills of the staff Christmas photograph, giant Collision, and oversized Chewbacca (prose only).
* Wild Things Games original aftermarket merch (Talaga chapter at 22:01) still not dested as memorabilia; leftover Decipher backstock (trays, uncut sheets) dested in Leftover stock.
* German Modern Graphics rulebook already on [[Cancelled German release of SWCCG]].
* Magazine inserts (Leia / Boba / R'kik) already on [[Oversized cards]].
* Seven Borg / Eight Lukes stills redundant with the fold-out crop.
* Executive Gift Set box already on the page from Encyclopedia p. 109.
* Hills Wholesale leftover sealed product dested in Leftover stock; NFC cutting and LOTR Chinese Elrond (end of the same video) still left out.
* Clip-art sheet right edge is cropped (Japanese ad sits against it on Encyclopedia p. 169).
* Organizer's Guide scan has a Pirate Pete watermark through the paper; kept with Photo credit.
